stem: A crop calendar is built only from advertised days-to-finish and ignores propagation readiness, room turnover, post-harvest capacity and environmental risk. What is the strongest critique?
choices: The schedule is complete because cultivar timing is the only constraint
The schedule is fragile because biological readiness and system bottlenecks must be incorporated into planning
The only missing factor is seed cost
Post-harvest capacity cannot affect crop scheduling
rationale: Crop planning is a systems problem. Biological stage readiness, room/equipment capacity and downstream bottlenecks can all shift feasible timing.
